description: This file defines a Spring Data JPA repository interface for managing Event entities, including custom query methods for filtering events by time and client.

classes.name: EventRepository
classes.description: A Spring Data JPA repository interface for Event entities, providing custom query methods.

methods.name: findByTimeAfter
methods.description: Finds all Event entities with a time after the specified LocalDateTime.

methods.name: findByTimeBetween
methods.description: Finds all Event entities with a time between the specified start and end LocalDateTime values.

methods.name: findByClient
methods.description: Finds all Event entities associated with the specified Client.
